note: What each detected box on the early trolley photographs is. These four photographs are catalog references; IMG_0252 and IMG_0254 are the query set and are deliberately not labelled here. The split is by photograph, which is the same discipline the shelf corpus uses and for the same reason: two crops of one photograph share the lighting, the angle and the item, so a crop-level split scores the recognizer on pictures it has already seen.
